source_records.title: Optical Mining of Asteroids, Moons, and Planets to Enable Sustainable Human Exploration and Space Industrialization
source_records.source_note: NASA describes a full-scale 8 kW vacuum demonstration using a 10 m solar concentrator and high-fidelity CI-type asteroid simulant without mechanical contact or downforce. Numerical accepted-product throughput and capture data are not reported on the accessible source page.

source_records.title: Optical mining of carbonaceous chondrite simulants: Testing and lessons learned in asteroid mining research
source_records.source_note: The accessible article text reports Tables 5 and 6 and experimental trends. Some rate plots are figure-only in the accessible extract. Water-loss efficiency is author-derived from RGA/pressure-gauge estimates, not a direct calibrated cold-trap product mass.

source_records.title: Asteroid laser mining under cryogenic vacuum conditions: Particle ejection and Fe–Ni enrichment from asteroid simulants
source_records.source_note: The accessible article abstract and excerpts report laser conditions and Fe–Ni enrichment. High-speed imaging, particle tracking and SEM–EDS are described. Numeric captured/refined product yield is not present in the accessible source extract.

source_records.title: Large-Scale Demonstration of Molten Regolith Electrolysis for Oxygen Production in a Relevant Environment
source_records.source_note: NASA NTRS presentation (ICES-2026-300) describing a 25 kg lunar simulant MRE campaign. Source-reported campaign KPIs are transcribed separately; voltage/current traces vary over time, so the summary 45 V/210 A is not integrated into campaign energy here.

source_records.title: Prototype Demonstration of Solar-Carbothermal System to Extract Oxygen From Regolith
source_records.source_note: NASA NTRS presentation describing an integrated solar concentrator, mirror, reactor, fluid, avionics/control and gas-analysis prototype. The accessible report confirms CO detection but does not give a numeric accepted purified-oxygen result.
